themes_detail.label: Street noise explosion
themes_detail.summary: Street and sidewalk noise complaints spiked to 30 THIS WEEK, up 300% from a 7.5-complaint weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 17.01), suggesting a sudden environmental or activity change affecting outdoor spaces in East New York/Cypress Hills.
evidence: 30 street/sidewalk noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 7.5 weekly average (z-score: 17.01)
This represents a 300% spike from baseline, the highest z-score among all active spikes
Concurrent with park noise spike (3 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 avg) and unleashed dog complaints (3 last week vs. 0.5 avg), suggesting outdoor activity pattern change
reporting_angles: Identify what triggered the noise surge: new vendor activity, event, or construction in the district this week?
Interview residents in high-complaint areas about what they're hearing and when

themes_detail.label: Park noise and activity surge
themes_detail.summary: Park-related noise complaints hit 3 THIS WEEK versus 0.1 weekly average (2300% spike, z-score: 8.69), suggesting a sudden change in park usage or vendor/event activity in East New York/Cypress Hills.
evidence: 3 park noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average (z-score: 8.69, 2300% increase)
Aligns with street/sidewalk noise spike and concurrent mobile food vendor complaints (3 complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.1 avg, z-score: 8.69)
Vendor enforcement complaints also elevated at 10 last week vs. 2.0 weekly average (400% spike)
reporting_angles: What parks are seeing the increased complaints and what activities are driving them?
Is there unauthorized vendor activity or an event happening in district parks?

themes_detail.label: Graffiti outbreak 2 weeks ago
themes_detail.summary: Graffiti complaints peaked at 39 TWO WEEKS AGO, up 791% from 4.4 weekly average (z-score: 8.66), marking a significant but slightly aging spike that may indicate a tagging campaign or coordinated vandalism event.
evidence: 39 graffiti complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 4.4 weekly average (z-score: 8.66, 791% spike)
This is the highest absolute complaint count in any spike category over the 90-day window
Timing suggests the outbreak may have peaked; monitor whether complaints are declining or sustained
reporting_angles: Was there a specific tagging campaign or gang-related activity two weeks ago? Check with NYPD and Parks Enforcement
Map where the 39 complaints clustered geographically to identify most-affected neighborhoods

themes_detail.label: Street sweeping failures escalate
themes_detail.summary: Street sweeping complaints spiked to 23 LAST WEEK, up 700% from 2.9 weekly average (z-score: 5.72), indicating sudden deterioration in sanitation services or street conditions across East New York/Cypress Hills.
evidence: 23 street sweeping complaints last week vs. 2.9 weekly average (z-score: 5.72, 700% increase)
Unsanitary condition complaints remain elevated at 843 over 90 days (top 6 complaint type), suggesting ongoing sanitation issues
May correlate with graffiti spike and street condition complaints (540 over 90 days)
reporting_angles: Has the Sanitation Department reduced street sweeping frequency or routes in CD 305?
Interview residents about specific streets or blocks where sweeping has deteriorated

themes_detail.label: Tree canopy crisis emerging
themes_detail.summary: Dead/dying tree complaints spiked to 3 THIS WEEK versus 0.4 weekly average (700% spike, z-score: 5.42), suggesting potential disease, pest infestation, or storm damage affecting the district's limited tree canopy.
evidence: 3 dead/dying tree complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average (z-score: 5.42, 700% increase)
Aligns with community board's repeated budget request to 'Improve access to a park or amenity' and tree maintenance needs
Suggests either a new environmental threat or delayed maintenance backlog surfacing this week
reporting_angles: Contact Parks Department to determine if a disease, pest, or storm event is affecting trees in the district
Document which specific trees or blocks are affected and map against canopy gaps in East New York
